title: ListOutstandingArchiveBatchesResponse
description: The response from listing outstanding archive batches.

eventBatches.description: The details about the outstanding batches of events.

nextPageToken.description: The page token for requesting the next page of results.

ArchiveBatch.description: Information about a batch of audit events that were archived.

accountId.description: The account ID for which events were archived.

eventCount.description: The number of events archived. A negative number indicates that the count is not available.

archiveId.description: The archive ID of the batch.

archiveTimestamp.description: The archive timestamp of the batch.
